newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Newell, Black & Decker started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Newell, Black & Decker started.

text.p: Natwest Securities said on Tuesday it started coverage of Newell Co and Black & Decker Corp with accumulate ratings.
-- Analyst James Lucas said both accumulate ratings were based on the companies' valuations.
-- Lucas said the underlying long-term investment thesis for Newell was positive, but the stock was trading just under 22 times earnings.
-- He said Black & Decker shares had also enjoyed a strong run this year, and that operating margins would continue to expand there.
-- "The product portfolio and the new product culture at Black & Decker is unmatched," he said.
-- Black & Decker gained 9/16 to 41-3/4 while Newell rose 1/4 to 42-1/8.
